title: Agile Project Management with Kanban | Eric Brechner | Talks at Google
summary: Eric Brechner, a Microsoft Xbox development manager, presents his Kanban approach for agile project management at Talks at Google. He covers using sticky notes to organize work, estimate and meet deadlines.
why: Recommended as a clear description of how Kanban works and a practical alternative to sprints.

quote.text: Eric Brechner of Microsoft (of all possible places...) gives a great talk on his team's approach
